secrets.playbook:
PREFECT_API_AUTH_STRING is user:password consumed by the Prefect server, every worker, and every flow-run block. Rotation is a coordinated restart:
  1. Choose a new auth string; update op://TS/Prefect/api_auth_string via rotate-secret --complete.
  2. The --complete fan-out re-pushes the server and worker Render services (server first restores API access).
  3. Re-save Prefect blocks: sync-secrets --repo /Users/simon/dev/ts-prefect --channel prefect (staging), then --dest prod with confirmation.
  4. Expect a brief API outage between server redeploy and worker/block convergence (--accept-brief-outage).

secrets.playbook:
The PROD decrypt proxy is deployed by the EXTERNAL client from their fork — not our Render, not manifest-routed. Rotation is a coordinated MANUAL step:
  1. Agree the new inbound bearer token with the external client (or have them mint it).
  2. Client updates DECRYPT_PROXY_AUTH_TOKEN on their prod deployment and redeploys.
  3. printf %s '<new-value>' | rotate-secret --ref 'op://TS/Decrypt proxy/auth_token' --reason '<why>' --complete
  4. ts-prefect prod prefect-tier rows are outside --changed fan-out: run `sync-secrets --repo /Users/simon/dev/ts-prefect --channel prefect --dest prod` so prod blocks/workers present the new token.
secrets.verify: ts-prefect prod flows authenticate against the client-deployed prod proxy with the new token (proxy health + a decrypt round-trip). ts-prefect consumes this token via its prefect-tier rows (prefect prod + dev ts-prefect-prod).

health_urls.$comment: Fail-closed health registry for the postgres rotator: every Render service a postgres registry entry targets MUST appear here with an endpoint returning HTTP 200 + {status:'ok', databaseRoleSafe:true}. Unregistered services refuse rotation (exit 3) before any mutation. The three amaru URLs are ported from amaru-web's rotator; the three workflow URLs cover workflow-pro prod/staging (/resources/healthcheck) and workflow-mcp (/health) from workflow_pro PR #562; the ts-dashboard URLs are the onrender hostnames of srv-d6h0kf7gi27c73a9ahmg (staging) and srv-d4uvcjqli9vc73ddv7hg (prod, ts-dashboard-spd5, no custom domain); the two autodev URLs cover autodev-dashboard (/healthz, autodev-dashboard PR #89) and autodev-memory (/health, autodev-memory PR #95), both attesting ALL configured DATABASE_URL_* connections against an EXPECTED_DB_ROLES accept-list.
